problem_statement: Build a brand-new /speaking page from scratch on the Astrofy Astro + TailwindCSS personal-portfolio template. The route /speaking does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty stub). Create src/pages/speaking.astro that wraps the page in the site's BaseLayout so it reuses the EXACT shared chrome of the other pages (index/cv/projects): the Header nav, the SideBar menu with Home/Projects/CV/Contact links, the Footer with the Astrofy Template credit, the daisyUI 'lofi' theme and Tailwind tokens. The page is a conference-talks list: a hero-style intro (h1 'Speaking' + one-line lede), a data-driven list of talk cards rendered from an INLINE static dataset (each card = talk title h3, venue/year line, short description), a filter bar (All / 2024 / 2023 / Keynotes buttons in the site's daisyUI button style), and a live count heading that reflects how many talks are visible. Clicking a filter hides non-matching cards and swaps the count (e.g. Keynotes -> 'Showing 2 talks'). Static data only, no backend/API.
required_content: A hero-style intro: h1 'Speaking' plus a one-line lede paragraph 'Conference talks, keynotes and workshops I have given over the years — filter them by year or format below.', inside the shared BaseLayout shell so the site nav sits above it.

The page MUST reuse the site's shared chrome by wrapping in BaseLayout: the SideBar nav (Home/Projects/Services/Store/Blog/CV/Contact links) and the Footer (Developed by ... Astrofy Template credit) — identical to index/cv/projects (cross-page consistency).

A data-driven list of talk cards from an inline static array: at least 'Scaling Astro at the Edge', 'Islands Architecture in Practice', 'From Blog to Platform', 'Content Collections Deep Dive', 'Zero-JS by Default' — each an h3 title + a venue/year line + a short description.
A filter bar of daisyUI buttons: All, 2024, 2023, Keynotes (each carrying a unique data-filter attribute).
A live count heading (h3, id talk-count) that starts at 'Showing 5 talks' and updates to reflect the visible cards after filtering.

Client-side filter interaction: clicking 'Keynotes' shows only the two keynote talks and updates the count heading to 'Showing 2 talks'; other filters toggle by year. Must not lose the shared nav/footer when it updates.
design_constraints: Wrap the page in BaseLayout (Header nav + SideBar menu + Footer) via <BaseLayout title="Speaking" sideBarActiveItemID="speaking">; do NOT hand-roll the header/footer/nav chrome.
Reuse the daisyUI 'lofi' theme and the site's Tailwind tokens (bg-base-100, card/shadow, btn / btn-sm / btn-outline / btn-active) — no new fonts/colors/theme.
Talk data must be INLINE static (a const array in the .astro frontmatter); do not fetch from any API/backend (it won't be running during capture).
Give each interactive filter button a unique data-filter attribute and target it by that attribute (not shell-chrome text).
